extraction.name: ArtifactsBench
extraction.description: A benchmark and automated, multimodal evaluation paradigm for visual code generation, containing 1,825 diverse tasks to evaluate LLMs on interactive visual artifacts.
extraction.creator: Tencent Hunyuan Team
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Candidates are aggregated from expert showcases, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots. Automated filters drop incomplete, non-visual, license-violating, duplicate, trivial, or non-interactive items.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Web Scraping, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Expert showcases, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Experts rewrite prompts for clarity, completeness, and executability; LLM rewriting adds diverse styles; humans verify. Difficulty is assigned post hoc by aggregated performance of 30+ models to enforce a 30%/40%/30% split.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Two-stage filtering for de-duplication and contamination control: (i) MinHash + semantic similarity over prompts, checklists, and normalized DOM/CSS/JS; (ii) screenshot perceptual hashing to catch visually near-identical artifacts. Underspecified items are pruned.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each query is paired with a 10-dimension checklist covering visual, interactional, and code qualities. Checklists are LLM-drafted and then human-refined for specificity and screenability. A 10% manually curated seed anchors calibration.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: A 10% manually curated seed anchors calibration and achieves Cohen’s kappa >= 0.8 among annotators; the seed is reused as few-shot references to keep difficulty high and rubrics consistent.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Engineers with extensive front-end development experience.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The discrete sampling methodology (three-step screenshots) may not fully capture the fluidity, correctness, and robustness of highly complex, long-horizon, or state-dependent interactions. It also focuses on evaluating the final artifact generated in a single turn and does not assess an LLM's capability to function as an autonomous agent.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating LLMs on interactive visual artifacts, fine-grained capability analysis, and automated multimodal evaluation for visual code generation.
